holes.question: Which existing owner issues the UADD request and challenge receipt without importing Rune's whole activity model or making Pantheon a truth owner?
How does the request bind the exact strict J1 receipt and human-readable challenged bytes while retaining opaque owner references and content minimization?
Which owner-issued fields distinguish a user-adversary attempt, a conclusive challenge, challenge unavailable and challenge inconclusive?
How are all applicable STRIDE dispositions, attempted routes, protected effects, countermeasure evidence and independent corroboration bounded without retaining secrets or unsafe payloads?
How does finding triage bind resolved current-slice findings to a new strict receipt while retaining adjacent work with an owner, evidence and priority?
Must the adversary and acceptor be the same named principal, or may an authorized delegate act under a separately explicit owner policy?
How is a generic Moira human-gate response owner-typed as a UADD response so an unrelated Approved response can never enter this composition?
Which exact response-to-Chronos mapping is owner-authorized, and what is the durable non-mutating disposition of Rejected?
Which stable invocation identity and lookup contract survive a lost Chronos reply without reusing a human response after strict evidence changes?
Which RED, USE and golden-signal event, log, metric and trace fields expose request, challenge, finding, response and task-effect outcomes without sensitive content?

rosetta.intent: bind one exact qualified J1 delivery to a named-user adversarial challenge, complete finding disposition and a later explicit acceptance decision, then prepare and reconcile at most one owner-specific Chronos review operation
outcomes: one owner-issued UADD request binds the named acceptance principal, strict J1 receipt, exact challenged material, task attempt, criteria, threat inventory, policy and decision packet
one separately attributable challenge receipt records the actual user's bounded adversarial attempts against the exact delivered version without implying acceptance
finding triage proves every current-slice blocker resolved against a new strict receipt and retains every adjacent finding with an owner, evidence and priority
a later Aegis-authorized UADD response from the named acceptance principal binds the same request, strict receipt, challenged version and current rationale

only a closed typed composition may prepare Approved as Accepted or ChangesRequested as RevisionRequired while Deferred remains in the Maybe Machine and Rejected remains a distinct non-mutating outcome
Chronos execution or lookup evidence remains distinct from human acceptance and grants no rollout authority
rosetta.who: the named human sponsor or authorized delegate, Moira, Aegis, Pantheon, Chronos, Vellum and independently attributable security, user-advocacy and audit participants
rosetta.what: one bounded UADD-to-J1 evidence composition and closed Chronos-review adapter, not a new generic approval system
rosetta.when: after strict J1 evidence qualifies and before J1 acceptance, Done, dependency release or closure
rosetta.where: Moira UADD and human-gate evidence, Pantheon's effect-free composition boundary, selected Vellum material routes and Chronos review V10
rosetta.why: a generic Approved response, green tests, agent recommendation or successful challenge cannot prove that the actual user accepted the exact result after trying to break its introduced controls
rosetta.how: reuse canonical UADD ordering, bind exact owner receipts, reobserve strict J1 evidence before challenge, response preparation and Chronos mutation, preserve every non-success outcome, and execute or look up one stable Chronos invocation without blind retry
rosetta.extent: one J1 attempt and one acceptance cycle; no arbitrary task mutation, generic approval inference, agent-authored human response, timeout-as-consent, finding suppression, shell fallback, go-no-go or rollout authority
examples: the accountable human challenges exact strict receipt E, all current findings are resolved, an adjacent usability finding is durably owned, and the human later approves E; Pantheon prepares one V10 Accepted command and Chronos alone commits Done
the human defers after a conclusive challenge, so the exact composition remains held in the Maybe Machine and no Chronos operation is prepared
the implementation changes after challenge, so the old receipt and response refuse rather than retargeting the new result
